data.name: PCSX2 GameIndex
data.credits: PCSX2 team; game data based on sonyindex.com, serialstation.com, psxdatacenter.com and redump.org

data.name: libretro-database, Sony - PlayStation 2 (developer DAT, PSXDataCenter)

data.fields: label (en, ru), genre (P136), developer (P178), publisher (P123), publication date (P577), PlayStation ID (P2606), en and ru Wikipedia article titles; matched to serials by PlayStation ID or by title

art.name: libretro-thumbnails, Sony - PlayStation 2

art.name: ScreenScraper
